title: Highlight only failing coatings above 5.0% drift spec line
what: failing coatings TiN-3 (7.8%) and BN-6 (6.4%) exceeding the 5.0% drift spec

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Only two coatings fail the 5.0% drift limit: TiN-3 (7.8%, +2.8 pp over) and BN-6 (6.4%, +1.4 pp over).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; both TiN-3 (7.8 ± 0.5%) and BN-6 (6.4 ± 0.5%) sit well above 5.0% outside ±1 SD.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: The five other coatings (ZrO-4 through HfO-5) all remain below 4.0% drift, comfortably passing qualification.
